title: Skeleton
description: Shimmer placeholders while content loads: Skeleton blocks, SkeletonCard, SkeletonGrid, SkeletonRows, PageSkeleton; Loading announces the region. Never “Đang tải…” text.
when: Any content that is loading: show its shape.
a11y: Loading (and the Skeleton* groups with label) set role="status" + aria-busy so screen readers hear one message.
